reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Stalls on bench usually come down to three things: not enough volume at a weight you can own, a weak point like the lockout or the bottom, or recovery not keeping up. Pick one working weight you can do for 3 sets of 5 with a rep or two in the tank, add a small amount each week, and deload every fourth week. Film your bench from the side and check your bar path and your touch point on the chest. Tell me what your current top set looks like and I'll help you build the plan around it."}
